title: Contents Packout & Storage Closing Payment: Declined Contents Lines and the Disputed Amount
content:
**Q. When do lines the carrier declined end up in the closing payment?**

A. Lines the carrier declined on the contents coverage stay with the customer where the arrangement bills them: the closing payment on an insurance-funded Contents Packout & Storage job carries the carrier denied line write-offs recorded on the contents coverage less the disputed amount, never below zero; the disputed amount is the amount the most recent contents-coverage price variance supplement request asks for when the arrangement bills denied lines to the customer and that request is named by no carrier approval, it is nothing when the arrangement bills denied lines to the customer and no such request awaits a decision, and in every other case it is the whole of those write-offs.

**Q. Which request is the most recent?**

A. The price variance supplement request on the contents coverage carrying the highest supplement number on the linked Insurance Claim Services claim file.

**Q. What does each case give?**

| Billing arrangement bills denied lines to the customer | Most recent price variance request | Disputed amount | Closing payment carries |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | named by no carrier approval | that request's amount | write-offs less that amount, never below zero |
| yes | none awaiting a decision | nothing | all the write-offs |
| no, or no linked claim file | — | all the write-offs | nothing |

**Q. Example?**

A. Write-offs of 1,180.00 under an arrangement that bills denied lines, with an undecided price variance request for 430.00: the closing payment carries 750.00.
